basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast from Johannesburg, South Africa, exploring the world of smartphones and gadgets. I recently switched from an iPhone to a OnePlus and love discovering new features. I work as a junior software developer during the weekdays and tinker with tech in my free time. I'm single and enjoy watching anime, especially Eureka Seven, in the evenings. I tend to browse Reddit late at night, usually around 10 PM to 1 AM local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, which sparked my interest in software and technology. Most of my knowledge about smartphones and live wallpapers comes from personal interest and online research. I'm still learning and often rely on community discussions for deeper insights.
